description: This source file defines the 'PopupMetaDataParser' class, which extends 'ListLayoutMetaDataParser' and is responsible for parsing and managing metadata related to popup views in a SuiteCRM module. It handles merging view definitions, converting search definitions to list definitions, and saving configuration data for popup views.

classes.name: PopupMetaDataParser
classes.description: A class for parsing and managing popup metadata definitions in SuiteCRM, supporting view merging, search-to-list conversion, and configuration persistence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with view type, module name, and optional package name, setting up columns and parent class accordingly.

methods.name: mergeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Merges view definitions with field definitions, converting search definitions to list definitions for consistency.

methods.name: convertSearchToListDefs
methods.description: Converts search view definitions into list view definitions by standardizing array structures.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieves the original view definitions, converted to list defs format.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Extracts search fields from the view definitions, including labels.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the popup view metadata configuration to the appropriate file, handling search and list views separately.

methods.name: addNewSearchDef
methods.description: Adds new search definitions to popup metadata.

methods.name: _diffAndUpdate
methods.description: Internal method to synchronize new definitions with existing target definitions, supporting 'where' clause handling.

methods.name: _getTargetModuleName
methods.description: Determines the module name suffix based on field definitions, used in constructing meta-configuration.
